name: Vibrant Design
tagline: Website, section, UI, and launch video references
description:
Vibrant Design collects website layouts, page sections, UI work, launch videos, tools, and Open Graph images. Browse the full website gallery or choose a section such as a hero, pricing table, FAQ, or footer.

The public galleries are open to browse. Saved moodboards require sign-in. The license states that featured work belongs to its original creators and is shown for inspiration.
pricing_detail: Public galleries can be browsed without payment or sign-in. Saved moodboards require an account. Paid features and prices were not confirmed. Featured work stays under its original creator rights. See https://vibrant.design/licence.
agent_guidance: Use the gallery to compare page layouts, section structure, UI details, and launch video styles before building a design. Open the original source for each reference. Check creator rights before reusing artwork or media. Saved moodboards need sign-in. No documented package, registry, or public API was found in the checked pages.
why_it_matters: It brings website, section, UI, video, and social card references into one gallery, so a design search can span several formats.
tier_reason: The public galleries organize varied visual references and link to their sources. The featured work is for inspiration, and no agent interface was documented in the checked pages.
evidence: Checked https://vibrant.design/, /websites, /sections/hero, /launch-videos, /tools, /og-images, /terms, and /licence on 2026-10-04. The moodboards link opened the dashboard, which showed a sign-in dialog. The homepage returned HTTP 200 and supplied the official preview at https://vibrant.design/banner.jpg. Public navigation includes website and section galleries, a tools directory, launch videos, and social card references.
